Version: 1.3.3 (crates.io)

Jasper local patches:
1. Remove the now-stable error_in_core feature gate for the pinned nightly.
2. Preserve the real directory-entry file type instead of hard-coding directory.
3. Treat parent inode 0 as the root sentinel and return ENOTDIR instead of
   panicking when a caller supplies a non-directory parent.

These files are otherwise the crates.io 1.3.3 source used by the FS-1 backend.
